statement: Let freq(v) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v. Let M be the maximum of freq(v) over all integers v with freq(v) > 0, and let K be the number of integers v with freq(v) = M. The function returns a result r and r = M * K (equivalently, r is the sum of freq(v) over all integers v with freq(v) = M).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.
